protocol.purpose: Distinguish weak learned conditioning from a weak residual path, and characterize remaining validation errors before designing training changes.
protocol.selected_weights: Existing Stage30 best validation macro Dice; immutable.
interventions: same fixed derangement of per-image channel logits across all layers
cross_channel_scale only: equal scale, mean scale logits, permuted scale logits, jointly permuted channel/scale, remove each residual level
protocol.interpretation: Post-training counterfactuals, not retrained ablations. Validation means use no labels and are diagnostic only, not proposed deployable checkpoints. Permutation preserves empirical raw-logit marginals and cross-layer alignment, not image correspondence. No test-based selection.
protocol.metrics: Original common evaluation.py definitions, all metrics and per-image rows for interventions; exact original prediction replay mandatory.
protocol.decision: Do not launch new modules until results support a concrete hypothesis; no automatic tuning sweep.
